parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password or token for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the ONE_PASSWORD environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The ENDPOINT URL of the XMLRPC server. If not specified then the value of the ONE_URL environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The name of the user for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the ONE_USERNAME environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: create
parameters.description: Whether the image should be created if not present. This is ignored if state=absent. Choices: false true

parameters.name: datastore_id
parameters.description: Use with create=true to specify datastore for image.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Whether the image should be enabled or disabled. Choices: false true

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A id of the image you would like to manage.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A name of the image you would like to manage. Required if create=true.

parameters.name: new_name
parameters.description: A name that is assigned to the existing or new image. In the case of cloning, by default new_name is set to the name of the origin image with the prefix ‘Copy of’.

parameters.name: persistent
parameters.description: Whether the image should be persistent or non-persistent. Choices: false true

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: present - state that is used to manage the image. absent - delete the image. cloned - clone the image. renamed - rename the image to the new_name. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent" "cloned" "renamed"

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: Use with create=true to specify image template.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to validate the TLS/SSL certificates or not. This parameter is ignored if PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY environment variable is used. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Seconds to wait until image is ready, deleted or cloned. Default: 60

examples:
- name: Fetch the IMAGE by id
  community.general.one_image:
    id: 45
  register: result

- name: Print the IMAGE properties
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    var: result

- name: Rename existing IMAGE
  community.general.one_image:
    id: 34
    state: renamed
    new_name: bar-image

- name: Disable the IMAGE by id
  community.general.one_image:
    id: 37
    enabled: false

- name: Make the IMAGE persistent
  community.general.one_image:
    id: 37
    persistent: true

- name: Enable the IMAGE by name
  community.general.one_image:
    name: bar-image
    enabled: true

- name: Clone the IMAGE by name
  community.general.one_image:
    name: bar-image
    state: cloned
    new_name: bar-image-clone
  register: result

- name: Delete the IMAGE by id
  community.general.one_image:
    id: '{{ result.id }}'
    state: absent

- name: Make sure IMAGE is present
  community.general.one_image:
    name: myyy-image
    state: present
    create: true
    datastore_id: 100
    template: |
      PATH = "/var/tmp/image"
      TYPE = "OS"
      SIZE = 20512
      FORMAT = "qcow2"
      PERSISTENT = "Yes"
      DEV_PREFIX = "vd"

- name: Make sure IMAGE is present with a longer timeout
  community.general.one_image:
    name: big-image
    state: present
    create: true
    datastore_id: 100
    wait_timeout: 900
    template: |-
      PATH = "https://192.0.2.200/repo/tipa_image.raw"
      TYPE = "OS"
      SIZE = 82048
      FORMAT = "raw"
      PERSISTENT = "Yes"
      DEV_PREFIX = "vd"
